'''Tatooine Militia''' was the building that housed the [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]] [[Tatooine militia|militia]], and was also used as the permanent base for any [[Stormtrooper/Legends|stormtroopers]] stationed in [[Mos Eisley/Legends|Mos Eisley]].<ref name="GG7" />
